verdict.rationale: The public business-tax-forms page on revenue.delaware.gov, which the probe confirms is the open, crawlable surface, lists specific forms such as the BUS-RDC application and computation schedule. FAQs also reference forms like the Request for Change and Amended GR Return, while authenticated sessions are needed only for the tax.delaware.gov filing portal. missing for 10: explicit evidence of downloadable files (e.g. PDF links), evidence that instructions accompany the forms, hands-on confirmation of a no-login download.

support.subject: As a founder, the forms themselves and their instructions are downloadable from the service's site without an account
